body:
jess: Heads-up — sketching a 'fallback runbook' panel for the Console that shows why an automatic fallback fired, suggested mitigation steps, and an audit trail. Quick sync?

samir: SG. Scope question — is this purely UI, or do we need new backend event labels?

jess: Both. Plan is to enrich telemetry with fields: fallback_reason, trigger_type, fallback_model, signal_snapshot, and an optional human_annotation we persist in the audit log.

marta: Heads-up from legal/security: free-text annotations can leak PII. Can we limit annotations to structured tags + an optional private note that is redacted in exports?

kevin: +1 on structured tags. Also want immutability for auditability — once a fallback decision is recorded it should be append-only (notes allowed but not edits).

anya: UX idea: show the top 3 contributing signals (e.g., p90 latency breach, error-rate spike, model OOM) with a link to the trace and a small histogram. @marta does that trigger any export concerns?

deploy-bot: deploy.prodx: rollout/auto-fallback-service v2.1.3 deployed at 1899990020 :rocket:

samir: For trigger thresholds we should let teams tune signal weightings. UI could expose a "simple" slider for sensitivity and an "advanced" JSON preview for power users.

jess: Sketch (inline): panel sections = [timeline, primary trigger, contributing signals, recent audits, "revert fallback" action]. Revert should require 2 approvals by default.

marta: Approvals: prefer using SAML groups or existing org groups rather than email lists to avoid manual invites. Also need export redaction rules.

kevin: Use existing RBAC scope 'deployment.rollback'. Approval modal can enumerate approvers and capture a justification string (append-only).

anya: Also surface estimated cost delta when fallback fired (tokens/latency cost) — helps SRE and product decide whether to tolerate fallback.

jess: Good call. Backend needs to compute cost delta per window; approximate with sampling and weights initially.

samir: Example policy JSON for advanced mode:
```
{
  "fallback_policy": {
    "triggers": [
      {"metric":"p90_latency","threshold_ms":1200,"weight":0.6},
      {"metric":"error_rate","threshold":0.05,"weight":0.4}
    ],
    "mode":"graceful_degrade",
    "min_cooldown_s":300,
    "audit_required":true
  }
}
```

marta: We also need retention policies for audit logs. Compliance requests 1 year by default, configurable up to 7 years. Exports should obey redaction rules.

kevin: Operational note: add flapping protection (min_cooldown + max-toggle-per-hour) and an alert when fallback toggles > X times in window.

jess: Action items: samir -> define telemetry schema + retention knobs; kevin -> RBAC + approval flow spec; anya -> mockups + cost-delta calc; marta -> security/PII export rules. I'll put a short RFC on this and schedule a 30m sync. Thanks all :thumbsup:
